caption: A car's defroster is switched on against a windshield fogged from the inside, and a clear patch spreads upward from the vents.

sa.check: A windshield is fogged on the inside.
A clear patch appears just above the dashboard vents.
The clear patch grows upward and outward.
The fog is thick before the switch.
The clearing comes after the switch.

pc.expect: The clear area only grows outward from the vents and glass that has cleared stays clear while the defroster runs.
pc.fail: Fog grows back on glass that had cleared while the defroster runs; or the clear patch shrinks; or the glass clears and fogs in turn; or the fog thickens while the defroster runs.

pc.expect: The clearing starts just above the vents and spreads from there, and it starts after the switch.
pc.fail: The clearing starts at the windshield's top and works down; or the whole windshield clears at once with no spreading edge; or the glass clears before the defroster is switched on; or the clearing starts in a corner far from any vent.

pc.expect: Drops in the fog that grow large enough run downward on the inner face of the glass.
pc.fail: A drop runs up the windshield; or a drop leaves the glass and rises; or water gathers along the glass's top edge and stays.

pc.expect: The fog is a fine haze that thins evenly at the clearing edge, and the glass stays a rigid clear pane.
pc.fail: The fog peels away as a film; or the fog slides down the glass as a sheet; or the haze turns opaque white like paint; or the glass flexes as it clears.

pc.expect: One windshield; what is seen through the cleared glass is the scene outside the car.
pc.fail: Objects outside appear or vanish as the glass clears; or a second windshield appears; or the windshield changes shape; or the dashboard vents vanish.

pc.expect: Everything in view, named in the caption or not, keeps its number, identity and shape unless something visible acts on it, and nothing passes through anything else.
pc.fail: An object that nothing visible acts on appears from nothing; or vanishes while still in frame and not occluded; or duplicates or merges with another; or turns into a different object or a different shape between frames; or any object passes through another. Changes brought about by the caption's event or by a visible interaction, objects leaving the frame, and occlusion are not failures.

pc.expect: The dashboard, the vents and the view outside stay the same apart from the clearing.
pc.fail: The dashboard changes colour; or the vents change layout; or the scene outside jumps to a different place.
